findings.evidence: `rg -n "alexander_eq_neg_one_or_eq_zero_of_two|gradings: `-1` on"` shows the docstring at lines 249-250 and the statement at lines 251-252: `G.alexander x = -1 ∨ G.alexander x = 0`.
findings.fix: Either weaken the docstring to only say every generator has Alexander grading `-1` or `0`, or strengthen the theorem statement to include the `x = G.O`/`x = G.X` cases explicitly.
findings.issue: `alexander_eq_neg_one_or_eq_zero_of_two` is documented as giving `-1` on `G.O` and `0` on `G.X`, but the theorem statement only proves `G.alexander x = -1 ∨ G.alexander x = 0` for arbitrary `x`.

summary: One theorem docstring overstates the theorem by assigning the two grading values to specific marking states even though the statement only returns a disjunction for an arbitrary generator.
